papers.title: ReGA-PINN: A physics-informed neural network approach for dynamics modeling and control of remotely operated vehicles

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于水下航行器动力学建模与控制，与生物力学植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no FEA surrogate for structural design, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决水下航行器动力学建模与控制中的计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 提出ReGA-PINN方法，结合物理信息神经网络与正则化遗传算法
summary_zh.result: 实现了高效且准确的动力学建模与控制
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证模型性能

summary_en.motivation: To address computational efficiency in dynamics modeling and control of remotely operated vehicles.
summary_en.method: Proposes ReGA-PINN, integrating physics-informed neural networks with a regularized genetic algorithm.
summary_en.result: Achieves efficient and accurate dynamics modeling and control.

papers.title: Total Hip Arthroplasty in Adolescents – Literature review and own clinical experience
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Total hip arthroplasty in adolescent patients is still researched surgical procedure in terms of indications, outcomes and long-term survivorship. The purpose of this report is to assess the results from THA in teenagers from the literature and to add data from our own clinical practice in order to provide insights for clinical decision-making in this specific and unique age group. Material and Results: A systematic literature review was performed including studies reporting clinical, radiological, functional outcomes and survivorship of THA in adolescent patients for any cause, with a minimum follow-up of one year. We added data from our clinical experience of 4 cases with hip endoprostheses in teenagers. Overall results showed significant increase of Harris Hip Score (HHS) with more than 53 points postoperatively, reaching values over 90 points (93±2) which is considered a very good and excellent result. Ten years survival rate has been reported in more than 85% of cases, with aseptic loosening mainly of the acetabular component. Revision rate has been 14,4%, as the leading cause – acetabular loosening in 64% of the cases. Complications have been found to be 3,4%. Conclusion: Total hip arthroplasty is a highly effective option for adolescents with severe destruction of the hip joint. It has demonstrated very good survivorship, low complication rate and acceptable functional results. However, altered hip anatomy, an increased revision rate and the long term implant survival must be considered before performing THA in teenagers.
papers.venue: THE JOURNAL OF THE BULGARIAN ORTHOPAEDICS AND TRAUMA ASSOCIATION

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为青少年全髋关节置换术的临床综述，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no implant design or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估青少年全髋关节置换术的临床结果和长期存活率。
summary_zh.method: 系统文献综述结合4例临床病例分析。
summary_zh.result: 术后Harris髋关节评分显著提高，10年存活率超过85%。
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述和少量病例报告，无生物力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To assess clinical outcomes and long-term survivorship of total hip arthroplasty in adolescent patients.
summary_en.method: A systematic literature review supplemented with data from four clinical cases.
summary_en.result: Significant improvement in Harris Hip Score postoperatively and over 85% ten-year survival rate.
summary_en.validation: Literature review and small case series, no biomechanical validation.

papers.title: Capsular management in posterolateral total hip arthroplasty: impact on proprioception, balance, functional outcomes, and complications
papers.venue: Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术中关节囊处理对本体感觉和功能结果的影响，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical metrics; it is a clinical outcomes study without FEA or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术中不同关节囊处理方法对患者功能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床研究，比较关节囊修复与切除组的功能评分和并发症。
summary_zh.result: 关节囊修复组在平衡和本体感觉方面表现更优，但并发症无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床患者随访数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the impact of different capsular management techniques on functional outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study comparing capsular repair versus excision groups on balance, proprioception, and complications.
summary_en.result: Capsular repair improved balance and proprioception scores without increasing complication rates.

papers.title: Transfer learning–enhanced physics–informed DeepONet for predicting segment uplift during shield tunneling
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Civil Engineering, Huaqiao University, Xiamen 361021, Fujian, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Qipeng Cai
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Civil Engineering, Huaqiao University, Xiamen 361021, Fujian, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将迁移学习与物理信息DeepONet结合，用于预测隧道施工中的结构响应，其方法可迁移至生物力学中植入物-骨界面的代理建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on geotechnical engineering.

summary_zh.motivation: 盾构隧道施工中段隆起预测依赖昂贵数值模拟，需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出迁移学习增强的物理信息DeepONet，融合少量数据与物理约束。
summary_zh.result: 相比纯数据驱动模型，预测精度提升且训练成本降低。
summary_zh.validation: 基于有限元模拟案例验证，未涉及实验或实测数据。

summary_en.motivation: Predicting segment uplift during shield tunneling requires expensive numerical simulations, motivating the development of efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A transfer learning-enhanced physics-informed DeepONet is proposed, integrating limited data with physical constraints.
summary_en.result: The method achieves higher prediction accuracy and lower training cost compared to purely data-driven models.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on finite element simulation cases without experimental or field data.
